question: I keep hearing about the golden cross thing. Can you find me stocks where the 50 day moving average just crossed above the 200 day?
result_summary: 60 results (capped). Top: PUAL.LSE (Puma Alpha VCT, cross 2026-08-18, strength 0.995), MLVIE.PA (Integritas Viager SA, cross 2026-08-17, strength 0.991). Signal cross_ema50_ema200_up correctly matched. Many global stocks included (LSE, PA, etc.).
reason: Correctly identifies golden cross as ema50 crossing above ema200 (bullish), provides dates and strength scores. Not confused with death cross.

defects.desc: No asset_type filter prevents non-Common-Stock entries (e.g. VCTs/investment trusts like PUAL.LSE appearing at top). Client should add asset_type=['Common Stock'] but this was included in the call — PUAL.LSE may be misclassified as Common Stock in asset_universe.
